scope: Bounded original-worktree recovery audit, not a new queue or feature-completion claim.
authoritative_queue: docs/recovery-delivery-board.json on current origin/main remains the task authority; this artifact is evidence only.

method.equality: SHA1 Git blob header + exact filesystem bytes compared to git ls-tree blob IDs for all main paths, not path existence
method.history: git log origin/main --raw --no-abbrev; records exact matching prior blob where observed; evidence snapshots explicitly distinguished
method.excluded: node_modules, build/dependency caches, supabase/.temp, binary assets and historical artifacts payloads. No files edited/reset/stashed/deleted.
method.bounded_semantic_review: Compared diff summaries for22 differing runtime product source paths lacking an exact prior main blob; inspected priority absent packages and selected functional/authority deltas. Remaining differences are byte-classified or triaged, not fully accepted.

priority_findings.main_evidence: Main Connect VERSION1 says existing channels read-only and no disconnect RPC. No public social_connection_authorize/social_connections_status/social_connection_disconnect/social_connection_history/social_channel_refresh_begin definitions found on main.
priority_findings.production_metadata_evidence: Read-only pg_proc name/signature lookup returned zero rows for these functions, also zero for company_admin_* functions below. No table/customer/token values read.
priority_findings.next_outcome: Current owner/admin can inspect safe account status, explicitly disconnect a local connection with expected version, reopen persisted result/history, and recover a lost response without provider calls.
priority_findings.required_adaptation: Use current authoritative workspace-first role/session helper and actual-owner fallback; actor/workspace/final-dispatch fence, immutable exact nonce/CAS, safe token-free projection, current-channel dispatch integration. Keep current narrow viewport CSS. Old SQL and Connect cannot be copied wholesale.
proposed_paths: NEW CLI-generated current-authority connection lifecycle migration
NEW targeted unit/isolated PG/browser/production rollback fixtures
priority_findings.authority: Proposed to lead before any implementation. No source edits made.
priority_findings.provider_limits: Automatic refresh/current provider API versions, production credentials/scopes/app review and real publishing acceptance remain separate. Local credential removal is not provider-wide app revocation.

priority_findings.evidence: Old package provides private legal profile, roles, minutes, evidence-linked deadlines and private document project wrappers. Current Operations has ordinary company/contact/project/task dashboard and action plans; current main has no company_admin_* symbols and actual public function metadata returned none.
priority_findings.required_adaptation: Preserve current Operations canonical IDs/recovery, exact current document APIs and authorization; old helper checks only membership role and lacks current session, foundation actual-owner policy, guarded existing-function replacement and current private-data recovery. Do not apply old wrapper-renames as-is. No filing/e-signature/legal advice claim.

priority_findings.evidence: 16 original SVG symbols with accessible English/Greek metadata, rendering helper, preview and2unitchecks are absent from main. Old README explicitly states existing Community boolean likes do not store reaction IDs.
priority_findings.next_outcome: Recover the authored pack after visual/asset review, then explicit canonical reaction or sticker attachment contract with visibility/current actor/moderation and real persistence. Standalone gallery is not an accepted Community reaction journey.

priority_findings.evidence: Current main has occurrence preparation, canonical social draft writer, scoped Composer loader and current source authority. Old fixed2026-09-30 seeds and older account handoff cannot replace the newer current-source/CAS/private-link guards. Root/QA earlier actual canonical editorial acceptance is separate release evidence.
priority_findings.remaining: Fresh source review before future external send remains required; no wholesale port or old event availability claim.

priority_findings.evidence: Old adapter has explicit configured Meta/LinkedIn version/readiness, bounded provider JSON and Instagram container-status polling. Current main has durable attempts, current authority/channel/credentials preflight, checkpoint and reconciliation controls absent from old version.
priority_findings.next_outcome: Review official provider API versions and selectively reuse bounded response/version validation without replacing durable attempt/finalization flow. No sends, new spend or current provider readiness claim.

priority_findings.evidence: Current main adds staged owner lifecycle/canonical AI/editorial context, private scope recovery and source-safe generic rendering. Old professional renderer includes Giota-specific fallback copy; other old render variants and simpler private-session controllers would reintroduce hardcoded/removed assumptions. Exact differences retained per-file; no delete/reset requested.
